description: Set form field options: description, printable, required, read only, hidden until triggered, password, multiline, scrollable, font and size, selected by default, export value, list items, sort and multiple selection (Buttons and Forms panel)

checkedByDefault.description: Selected by Default (check boxes and radio buttons)

choices.description: List Items: the choices of a combo box or list box, replacing the existing ones

description.description: Description: the tooltip and alternative text in the PDF (PDF Options)

exportValue.description: Export Value submitted when selected (check boxes and radio buttons)

font.description: Font of the field text in the PDF (text fields, combo boxes and list boxes)

fontSize.description: Font Size in points for text fields, combo boxes and list boxes; 0 is Auto

hiddenUntilTriggered.description: Hidden Until Triggered: hidden in the PDF until a Show/Hide action shows it

printableInPdf.description: Printable: print the field with the PDF

required.description: Required: the field must be filled in

sortChoices.description: Sort Items alphabetically (combo boxes and list boxes)

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: set_form_field_options
title: Set Form Field Options
